subject.title: fix(memory): search by filenames and paths

question: Should the path-FTS trigger lifecycle helpers become permanent public memory SDK API, or remain an internal memory publication detail?
rationale: Correctness inspection cannot determine whether external plugins should receive a lasting contract for low-level table and trigger lifecycle operations.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Expose a higher-level memory publication operation and keep path-table and trigger mechanics within the memory owner boundary.

options.title: Approve public helpers
options.body: Retain the three exports and explicitly own their compatibility, documentation, and upgrade-test obligations.

recommendation.title: Keep lifecycle internal
recommendation.body: Expose a higher-level memory publication operation and keep path-table and trigger mechanics within the memory owner boundary.
